# Zoho CRM V8 APIs

- ### [Metadata APIs](https://zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/module-meta.html)

  [Fetch the metadata of modules, fields, layouts, custom views, and related lists.](https://zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/module-meta.html)
- ### [Core APIs](https://zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/get-records.html)

  [Perform CRUD operations on CRM module entities and integrate with any third party application through flexible RESTful endpoints.](https://zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/get-records.html)
- ### [Composite API](https://zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/composite-overview.html)

  [Combine up to five API calls in a single request through this API.](https://zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/composite-overview.html)
- ### [Bulk APIs](https://zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/bulk-read/overview.html)

  [Push and retrieve data from Zoho CRM in bulk using a set of asynchronous APIs.](https://zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/bulk-read/overview.html)
- ### [Notification APIs](https://zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/notifications/overview.html)

  [Get notified whenever a data change occurs inside your CRM.](https://zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/notifications/overview.html)
- ### [Query APIs](https://zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/COQL-Overview.html)

  [Fetch records using the SELECT query(SQL syntax) from Zoho CRM.](https://zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/COQL-Overview.html)
